claims.claim: Nil numeric and nonnumeric facts prohibit accuracy attributes; non-nil selected numeric facts require exactly one.
Finite decimals are accuracy metadata, not a multiplier; INF asserts an exact represented value.
The corrected decimal-place definition invokes nearest rounding with ties to even.
For grid output kq, inverse endpoints are both included for even k and both excluded for odd k.
Off-grid lexical values cannot be outputs of the stated map; inverse construction is withheld without choosing a normalization policy.
